description: Offensively test perimeter appliances and VPN crypto — IKE/IPsec aggressive mode, transform/DH enumeration, safe firmware/version inference for FortiGate / PAN-OS / Cisco ASA / Citrix feeding CVE applicability, TLS-version posture, and NTLM Type-2 info leaks. Load when an edge firewall, VPN, or load balancer is in scope. Signals: UDP 500/4500, ports 4433/10443/443 on an appliance, "SSL-VPN"/"Global Protect"/"Pulse"/"NetScaler" banners, Check Point SIC (18190/18191).
